lines.text: For wheelchair users, range isn't just a spec. It's every single day.
So we size the pack from your drive system and the daily range you want to offer.
Matched to your system voltage, like twenty-four volts, and to your charger.
LiFePO4 for long cycle life, or lithium-ion when weight comes first.
And the B M S reports the charge straight to your controller or display.
Lighter pack or longer life... what do your users need most? Tell us in the comments!
